连接自己的订阅，选择照片分析与图像生成模型: Connect your subscription and choose analysis and image models
完整插画边框自动跟随最终画幅。这里的尺寸用于独立装饰素材。: Illustrated borders follow the final canvas orientation. This size applies to standalone decoration assets.
完整边框与装饰素材使用此处的生图服务。用 ChatGPT 登录后，可以在分析配框: Illustrated borders and assets use this image service. Sign in with ChatGPT to make editable borders in Photo-led design.
由本机 Pi 的服务商适配器完成授权、模型目录和请求。连接失败不会切换计费方式。: The local Pi provider handles authorization, the model catalog and requests. A failed connection never changes the billing method.
尚未找到 Pi，需要先安装或选择程序: Pi not found. Install Pi or choose its program.
Pi 是可选的订阅连接组件。常规加框不需要 Pi，也不会为此下载本地模型或额外运: Pi is optional. Regular framing works without it; Liubai does not download local models or an extra runtime.
分析使用本机 Codex 的登录与额度；手绘生图另有独立设置。: Analysis uses the local Codex sign-in and allowance. Image generation has separate settings.
使用所填 API 项目的额度；此入口不等同于网站或聊天软件订阅。: Uses the specified API project's allowance. This is separate from a website or chat subscription.
Key 只在本次软件会话内保留，不进入模型配置文件或模板。: The key stays in this app session and is never saved in configuration or templates.
手绘生图与照片分析分别配置。默认继续使用本机 Codex。: Image generation is configured separately from photo analysis. Local Codex remains the default.
保存配置不会发起分析或生图请求。: Saving does not start analysis or image generation.
已保存账户授权 · 使用账户余额: Account authorization saved · Uses account balance
已保存订阅授权 · 请求时由 Pi 刷新: Subscription authorization saved · Pi refreshes on request
Pi 中保存的是 API Key；此订阅入口不会使用它: Pi has an API key saved. This subscription connection will not use it.
尚未连接此服务的订阅: This provider's subscription is not connected
与本机 Pi 共用授权。这里登录或退出，也会影响 Pi 中同一服务的连接。: Authorization is shared with local Pi. Signing in or out here also changes Pi's connection to this provider.
退出 Pi 中此服务: Sign out of this provider in Pi
等待服务商授权，不会发送照片。: Waiting for provider authorization. No photos are sent.
这里只粘贴授权码或回调链接；账户密码请在服务商官网输入。: Paste only an authorization code or callback link here. Enter your account password on the provider's website.
输入模型名称或 ID: Enter a model name or ID
没有匹配项，保留当前模型选择。: No matches. The current model remains selected.
Pi 模型目录不代表套餐一定允许调用；实际可用性由服务商确认。: A model in Pi's catalog may not be included in your plan. The provider determines actual access.
账户授权已保存到本机 Pi: Account authorization saved in local Pi
已退出 Pi 中此服务的本机连接: Signed out of this provider in local Pi
已保存 Pi 连接；确认后才会发送缩略图。: Pi connection saved. A thumbnail is sent only after your confirmation.
请在模型配置中连接订阅并选择支持图片输入的模型。: Connect your subscription and select a vision model in Model configuration.
同意通过 {0} 发送原图与配框缩略图，使用 {1} 调用 {2} 精修一轮: Allow {0} to send original and framed thumbnails and use {1} with {2} for one refinement
同意通过 {0} 发送此缩略图，使用 {1} 调用 {2} 分析配框: Allow {0} to send this thumbnail and use {1} with {2} for framing analysis
Pi 正在处理连接或分析，请先等待或取消: Pi is connecting or analyzing. Wait or cancel first.
授权步骤已结束，请重新连接: This authorization step has ended. Connect again.
尚未收到可打开的授权页面: No authorization page is available yet
Pi 设备记录无效，请检查应用数据目录: Invalid Pi device record. Check the app data folder.
无法保存 Pi 设备记录: Could not save the Pi device record
Pi 未返回完整的配框结果: Pi did not return complete framing results
请选择支持的 Pi 订阅服务: Select a supported Pi subscription provider
未找到可用的 Pi 与 Node，请在模型配置中选择已安装的 Pi 程序: Pi and Node were not found. Choose the installed Pi program in Model configuration.
Pi 连接意外中断，请重试: The Pi connection ended unexpectedly. Try again.
无法准备 Pi 临时环境: Could not prepare Pi's temporary environment
无法启动 Pi 模型连接，请检查程序路径: Could not start Pi. Check its program path.
无法建立 Pi 连接: Could not establish a Pi connection
Pi 连接协议不兼容，请检查 Pi 版本: Incompatible Pi protocol. Check the Pi version.
已取消 Pi 请求；已发出的请求可能仍计入服务商用量: Pi request canceled. Requests already sent may still count toward provider usage.
Pi 连接或分析超时，请手动重试: Pi connection or analysis timed out. Retry manually.
Pi 结束等待超时: Timed out waiting for Pi to exit
Pi 未返回完整结果: Pi did not return a complete result
Pi 订阅授权未就绪，请重新登录；不会自动改用 API Key: Pi subscription authorization is not ready. Sign in again. No API key fallback is used.
请选择支持图片输入的 Pi 模型: Select a Pi model that supports image input
此模型的订阅或账户用量已达限制，请到服务商查看: This model's subscription or account usage limit was reached. Check with the provider.
Pi 返回内容过大或格式无效: Pi returned too much data or an invalid format
Pi 模型没有完整完成响应，请手动重试: The Pi model did not complete its response. Retry manually.
Pi 模型连接失败，请检查网络、Pi 版本和订阅权限: Pi connection failed. Check your network, Pi version and subscription access.
Pi 返回了非官方授权地址，已停止打开: Pi returned an unrecognized authorization domain. The page was not opened.
